newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.152 bln stg, week to April 2.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.152 bln stg, week to April 2.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.152 billion stg in the week to April 2 from 25.351 billion stg the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 dipped to 25.541 billion stg from 25.582 billion the week before.
Notes and coins in circulation rose to 25.112 billion stg from 25.023 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis. Unadjusted notes and coins climbed to 25.501 billion stg from 25.254 billion.
